The model dispatches every megawatt hour the river and Mali's OMVS share allow, because hydro is the cheapest thing in the merit order. A model above the statistic means either the monthly availability table is too generous or the real plants are not run to their limit.

sibling.note: the two models use different demand bases — the sibling works at network entry and computes transmission losses, this one is a copper plate and carries those losses inside demand — so totals differ by construction and the mix is the comparable part
